job.question: How many working-group participant entries are listed in the appendix of the PRI covering note on the 2021 update of its private equity responsible investment DDQ (counting the joint TPG & Y Analytics entry once), and who represented CalPERS and CalSTRS?
job.expected_facts: 31 listed participant entries, counting TPG & Y Analytics once. CalPERS was represented by James Andrus; CalSTRS by Nicholas Abel.
job.acceptance: Accept 31 listed/grouped participant entries with James Andrus for CalPERS and Nicholas Abel for CalSTRS. A respondent flagging the joint TPG/Y Analytics counting issue should not be failed for not asserting 31 distinct organisations.
